observedCause: Early rejection and cancellation of an unfinished large request body withheld the response in the hosted path. Fully consuming a finite rejected body before returning removes the reproduced timeout. A cloned-body forwarding model reproduces the interaction; managed relay internals are not proven identical.

fix.overflow: Release stored chunks, discard the remainder of a finite body without retaining or parsing it, then return HTTP 413.
fix.stalledRead: 408 before detecting overflow; preserve 413 after overflow. Cancellation is never awaited.

scopeLimitations: Discard has a time bound, not a total-transit-byte cap or an early wire abort.
The function's retained bytes and parser input remain capped; no claim is made about buffering inside the managed relay.
Delivery after cancellation of an unfinished or endless body remains provider-dependent. This is a finite-upload workaround, not a provider runtime fix.

validation.retentionRegression: Rejected 8 MiB synthetic stream releases stored chunks; incremental retained ArrayBuffer memory stayed below 4 MiB under forced GC.
validation.liveBodies: Deliberately invalid multipart bytes; no valid XLSX submitted.
validation.validXlsxPreview: Isolated only; HTTP 200 without price publication.
validation.authorization: Isolated actual routes retain 401/403 before reading unauthorized uploads.
